root_cause: In get_openapi_path, each route's additional response dict is copied with a shallow dict.copy(); the nested 'content' dict is therefore shared with route.responses. App-level FastAPI(responses=...) makes every route share that same dict, so deep_dict_update merging the generated Union schema into process_response['content'][media_type] mutates the shared source, and each subsequent route appends another copy of the anyOf $refs.
best_solution: Replace `process_response = additional_response.copy()` with `process_response = copy.deepcopy(additional_response)` (plus `import copy`) in fastapi/openapi/utils.py get_openapi_path. A deep copy detaches the nested content/schema dicts from route.responses, so deep_dict_update only mutates a per-route throwaway and the shared app-level config stays pristine; every route gets exactly [ModelA, ModelB] in anyOf. The statement points at the exact line (shallow .copy()) and the mutation mechanism.
acceptable_alternatives: Deep-copying only the 'content' sub-dict, or building a fresh dict before deep_dict_update, would also pass; making deep_dict_update non-mutating (return a new dict) works too but touches a shared helper. Deduplicating anyOf entries would hide the symptom but still leak mutation into route.responses (and still grow the title/other merged keys).
hidden_test_demands: New file tests/test_additional_responses_union_duplicate_anyof.py::test_openapi_schema: app-level responses={500: {model: Union[ModelA, ModelB], content: {application/json: {examples: {...}}}}} with two routes; asserts the full /openapi.json equals an exact dict where each route's 500 schema has anyOf of exactly two $refs (ModelA, ModelB), a per-route title ('Response 500 Route1 Route1 Get' / 'Response 500 Route2 Route2 Get'), and the examples preserved.
locating_signals: Statement is the PR description and names the file (fastapi/openapi/utils.py), line range, the exact expression `additional_response.copy()` described as 'shallowly copied', and deep_dict_update as the mutator. Function get_openapi_path is implied by the linked snippet. Fix is effectively spelled out.
our_outcome_summary: Solved by all four configs (v4, v6, v7, v8 all kaggle_env_pass=true). Every agent patch applies the identical one-line change to copy.deepcopy plus import copy. v4/v7/v8 also left a stray reproduce_issue.py at repo root (harmless here). Pod cost: v6 fastest (62s, 20 calls), v8 slowest (176s, 48 calls) for the same patch.
generalizable_lesson: When a function builds per-item output from a shared config dict (app-level defaults, class attributes, module constants) and then merges into it with an in-place helper, a shallow .copy() leaks mutation across iterations; symptoms are output that grows with the number of items (duplicates accumulating in lists). Fix at the copy site with copy.deepcopy rather than deduplicating downstream. Also: clean up scratch reproduce scripts before finishing.
